about: Repeated Bash patterns found in Claude Code transcripts. scripts/analyse counts them, and a tool whose tool.json names a family takes it over: the PreToolUse hook reminds Claude of the tool when a Bash command matches the family. A command matches when every regex of any one rule matches (Ruby regex syntax). The toolsmith skill adds families as scans find new patterns.

families.title: a script that finds text in a file and replaces it
writing a docs/log history entry by hand
writing several files with heredocs in one command
polling a pull request's CI checks
merging a pull request and cleaning up the branch
staging, committing and pushing in one command
changing a value in a JSON file with a script
changing a YAML file with a script
reading line ranges of files with sed -n
running tests or lint and cutting the output with tail, grep or head
